title: Jeans mein ye chhoti si pocket kyun hoti hai? 👖

shots.vo: अपनी जीन्स देखो। सामने दाईं पॉकेट के अंदर, एक छोटी सी पॉकेट है। फ़ोन के लिए बहुत छोटी। चाबी के लिए भी बहुत छोटी।
shots.prompt: extreme close-up of the small watch pocket on the front of blue denim jeans, worn texture, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: Apni jeans dekho. Saamne daayin pocket ke andar, ek chhoti si pocket hai. Phone ke liye bahut chhoti. Chaabi ke liye bhi bahut chhoti.

shots.vo: तो ये किसलिए है? पॉकेट वॉच के लिए।
shots.prompt: an antique gold pocket watch on a chain resting on worn denim, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: To ye kisliye hai? Pocket watch ke liye.

shots.vo: अठारह सौ के दौर में, लेवी स्ट्रॉस ने खदान मज़दूरों, काउबॉयज़ और रेलवे वर्कर्स के लिए मज़बूत वर्क पैंट बनाई।
shots.prompt: a nineteenth-century gold miner in denim work pants beside a river in the American West, vintage painting style, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: Atharah sau ke daur mein, Levi Strauss ne khadaan mazdooron, cowboys aur railway workers ke liye mazboot work pants banayi.

shots.vo: तब रिस्ट वॉच आम नहीं थी। लोग चेन वाली घड़ी रखते थे।
shots.prompt: a cowboy pulling a pocket watch from his jeans by firelight, vintage painting style, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: Tab wrist watch aam nahi thi. Log chain wali ghadi rakhte the.

shots.vo: और बड़ी पॉकेट में घड़ी घिस जाती, दब जाती, या खो जाती।
shots.prompt: a cracked pocket watch lying in the dust beside a pickaxe, dramatic light, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: Aur badi pocket mein ghadi ghis jaati, dab jaati, ya kho jaati.

shots.vo: तो उन्होंने एक छोटी, कसी हुई पॉकेट जोड़ दी, जो घड़ी को सुरक्षित रखने के लिए बिल्कुल सही साइज़ की थी।
shots.prompt: a hand slipping a pocket watch into the small front pocket of jeans, close-up, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: To unhone ek chhoti, kasi hui pocket jod di, jo ghadi ko surakshit rakhne ke liye bilkul sahi size ki thi.

shots.vo: घड़ियाँ गायब हो गईं। पॉकेट नहीं गई। लेवी's आज भी इसे वॉच पॉकेट कहता है।
shots.prompt: modern blue jeans hanging in a sunlit room, the tiny pocket catching the light, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: Ghadiyan gayab ho gayin. Pocket nahi gayi. Levi's aaj bhi ise watch pocket kehta hai.

shots.vo: अब तुम जान गए हो, ये असल में किसलिए है।
shots.prompt: a person's hand tucking a coin into the tiny jeans pocket, warm light, close-up, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: Ab tum jaan gaye ho, ye asal mein kisliye hai.
